messages:
sasha: Heads-up — new community checkpoint arrived: umbrage-12b (float32 baseline). tagging for runtime/quantization triage. can we treat as medium priority?

alex: adding to intake. what are the known quirks? arch looks standard decoder-only 12B but repo notes mixed rotary+rope attention patches.

maya: interesting — model card says 'rotary embeddings with legacy RoPE toggles'. we should verify token offset invariants and KV cache alignment before any canary.

ryan: agreed. quick smoke plan: 
1) canonical forward on small seq (64) compare logits vs float32 baseline 
2) streaming next-token checks with KV reuse (seq 512 then +1) 
3) quant profiles q8_0 + q4f16 and check top-p divergence.

jenna: I'll run step 1 and 2 now on a dev GPU pool. posting command I used in case folks want to replicate: 
```
runtest --model umbrage-12b --mode smoke --seq-len 512 --kv-check --save-logs /tmp/umbrage-smoke.log
```

ciara-bot: job 45231 queued on dev-gpu-2; ETA ~3m.

alex: quick note — previous models with mixed rotary toggles showed phase drift when we reused KV caches assembled under an older rotary implementation. symptom: shifted attention peaks after 64 tokens. watch for that.

maya: got first logs. float32 baseline vs runtime FP32 match within numerical tol for short runs. but when I run streaming with KV reuse I see token-level logit drift around step 75. attaching snippet: 
```
step 72: top1=token_453 (p=0.12)
step 76: top1=token_512 (p=0.05)
expected continuity broken between 70-80
```

ryan: that smells like RoPE wrap/scale mismatch. two quick diagnostics: 
- compare rotary sin/cos buffer shapes at runtime vs repo conversion
- run with `--reset-kv-between-batches` to confirm KV reuse is culprit

jenna: ran with `--reset-kv-between-batches` and drift disappeared. so KV reuse + rotary mismatch confirmed.

alex: ok that's an interoperability issue. priority bump to high for runtime patch (or conversion re-run). who can own?

maya: I can own conversion fix. plan: audit embedding conversion code, ensure rotary frequency tables computed with same dtype/scale, add unit test that cycles through cache reuse for 0..512 tokens. estimate: 1d for patch + 1d for canary.

ryan: parallel: I'll start q8_0 quant runs but gate them behind a KV-fix branch. don't want to bake quant differences into false positives.

infra-bot: FYI — provisioning request for canary nodes submitted by sasha. canary window slot at 2026-03-23T02:00Z pending approval.

sasha: thanks. also want to capture eval metrics before/after: SQuAD F1 on standardized prompt set, perplexity on subset, and an in-house RLHF regression test. add to checklist.

jenna: adding checklist item: 
- reproduce float32 baseline perf (SQuAD, ppl)
- fix rotary/KV alignment
- run quant smoke (q8_0, q4f16) with diff thresholds (KL<0.02 top-k)
- run canary in dedicated slice (10% traffic)
- monitor cost and latency deltas

alex: also add a rollback plan that pins to previous verified model if drift > threshold or regen errors in streaming.

maya: starting the conversion audit now. will post a small PR with unit tests and a reproducer. tagging @ryan for quant gating.

sasha: perfect. thanks team — keep this thread for status updates. if we get a clean run, we'll schedule a traffic canary and a brief postmortem on findings. :thumbsup:
